date_note: Katadata (published 26 November) reports Mekari's 25 November statements; the page says unusual activity was detected on the morning of 25 November.
geo_basis: country as the source states it (Indonesia); no city given
title: Mekari says an external party attacked its systems; Talenta payroll and other apps disrupted
summary: Katadata reports that Mekari, the company behind Talenta, Qontak, Sign, Jurnal and Flex, said in a 25 November Instagram post that unusual activity was a cyberattack from an external party. Access to several apps was temporarily restricted, and users complained of delayed salary payments. Mekari said recovery will be gradual once systems are verified; the page does not say whether customer data was leaked.
plain: Mekari, an Indonesian business software firm, says an outside party attacked its systems. Some apps were restricted and payroll payments were delayed. Mekari says recovery will be gradual.
exec: Mekari says it was hit by a cyberattack; payroll payments through Talenta were delayed for client companies, per Katadata.
action: No action needed; for awareness. Mekari's CEO warns it never asks for passwords, OTP codes or payments by email, WhatsApp or phone.

validation.note: Only Katadata read, quoting Mekari's own Instagram post and CEO letter; no second publisher found in a search; Mekari's own pages not read.
